relation: strongly regular parameters: GTBase.strongly_regular.strongly_regular_parameters G k lam mu is the three unguarded clauses (regular G k; adjacent pairs have lam common neighbours; distinct non-adjacent pairs have mu). Two distinct existentials: has_strongly_regular_parameters (unguarded; Hom U3 srg/strongly_regular convert to the clauses and to it; K_2, the empty graph, complete, edgeless and clique-union graphs are accepted) and connected_nontrivial_strongly_regular (exactly connected [set: G], 0 < k and k < #|G|.-1; Spectral D5 strongly_regular is a proved iff, its flat five-conjunct body not being a conversion; K_{2,2} with (2,0,2) is in, K_2 and the degenerate graphs out). Only guarded implies unguarded. The adjacency-matrix identity A^2 = k I + lam A + mu (J - I - A) over int is Spectral.foundations.strongly_regular_matrix (equivalent to the clauses for all parameters, and with the same guards to the guarded existential); grounding_D5 sr_clauses/sr_mateq/strongly_regular_alg convert to the canonicals and its theorems are proved wrappers. GTBase does not import Spectral.
summary: Family A33 (strongly regular graphs). GTBase.strongly_regular owns the unguarded parameter predicate and two distinct existential wrappers: has_strongly_regular_parameters (U3: no connectivity or degree guard, K_2 accepted by grounding_U3.srg_K2) and connected_nontrivial_strongly_regular (D5: exactly connected, 0 < k and k < #|G|.-1; K_{2,2} with (2,0,2) in). No unguarded equivalence is claimed. The matrix identity and its two equivalences (introduced in grounding_D5, technique 3) are released as Spectral.foundations.strongly_regular_matrix; every grounding_D5 qualified name keeps its type and arguments as a proved wrapper.

Eight rows are frozen at the literal parent a69e27f (bodies byte-identical to a59246d for U3, 7c23ef2 for D5 and 9c47cd0 for the grounding matrix block; only statement doc comments changed since). The two whole statements keep their quantifiers, the eight-graph non-isomorphism clause and the live is_core/hom_equiv/triangle_free providers. The two frozen grounding theorems hold of the frozen bodies (legacy_sr_mateqE, legacy_strongly_regularE). No SRG name or common_nbr occurs in any migration module at the parent: this is scoped search evidence, not proof that no equivalent body was frozen elsewhere; the provider/history scan is part of the gate evidence.

Source repair (2026-10-25, PROGRAMME A2; record meta/STATEMENT_IMPROVEMENTS.md, triangle_free_strongly_regular_graphs entry), not a migration equivalence: the frozen D5Legacy eight-graph row is a theorem (K_{2,2}, ..., K_{9,9}; D5Legacy_row_holds in the certificate file), and the live D5 row now asks for an eighth triangle-free strongly regular graph with 0 < mu < k, isomorphic to none of the seven known graphs (Spectral.foundations.triangle_free_srg). The frozen row keeps the A33 text verbatim; its statement entry carries the repair (one exact text replacement, the pinned doc block, the record), and its certificate is kernel-checked as live -> frozen (the converse would solve the open problem).
